220260101.text: Hmm... it should be around here.

220260103.text: Huh? Oh, Traveler, it's you! Hehe, never expected to run into you here...

220260104.text: I'm here to look for ingredients. Xudong is working on new dishes, and Parvaneh is giving him ideas.

220260105.text: Xudong told me that he wanted to make a sweet and soft dish for dessert based on Inazuma's Tricolor Dango. But it would take several special ingredients to do so.

220260106.text: Uncle Munehisa went into town to buy some Lavender Melons. I'm here to gather what they call Sakura Blooms.

220260107.text: Although I have gathered some, it's still not enough yet. I wanted to go search ahead, but it's crawling with monsters...

220260108.text: Traveler, please. Could you please help me bring three Sakura Blooms back?

220260110.text: Thank you! I'll treat you to something great when you get back!

220260112.text: Well, that would generally be the case...

220260113.text: But, hmm, how do I put this? If I really have to fight against those monsters, I'll definitely forget about the ingredient-gathering mission.

220260114.text: I've been like this ever since I was in Mondstadt. Whenever I was dealing with monsters, I would forget about everything else.

220260115.text: Only after I completely defeated the monsters would I remember that I still had an assignment that required my attention... That's how I failed so many assignments...

220260116.text: You really hate monsters, don't you...

220260117.text: Hate them? No, not really... Actually, I find fighting them really fun...

220260118.text: Have you ever had that feeling, when you don't need to think about anything but defeating monsters? It's amazing.

220260119.text: Well, let's not dwell on that. So, please help me out with the Sakura Bloom-gathering mission, thanks!

220260120.text: I'll treat you to something great when you get back!

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for three Fresh Sakura Blooms

220260201.text: Have you gathered all the Sakura Blooms?

subQuests.subQuestName: Give three Fresh Sakura Blooms to Julie

220260301.text: Alright, these will do. Thanks! If it wasn't for you, I would have had to charge in there and deal with those monsters myself.

220260302.text: If that had happened, I really don't know when I would have remembered that I was tasked with gathering Sakura Blooms again...

220260303.text: Anyway, thank you for your help. Please take these Chicken-Mushroom Skewers. Miss Lynn taught me how to make this classic adventurers' dish.

220260304.text: I'll bring these Sakura Blooms back to Xudong. I wonder what kind of goodies he'll come up with...
